children.value: > Fact From Story: FTX lied about how much money was in the backstop fund

> > Fact From Story: In court we saw the code that generated the fake number published on the website: it took the daily trading volume on FTX, multiplied it by a random number, divided it by a billion, and added it to the existing number displayed on the site. | Deduced Fact
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Multiplying the daily trading volume by a random number has nothing to do with the actual amount of money in the insurance fund. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Fact From Story: FTX advertised that it had a good liquidation system.
> > Fact From Story: In many crypto networks, if someone lost enough money, the exchanges could stick other traders with the losses too.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People do not like losing their money.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Lying about the amount of money in a backstop fund is obfuscating basic elements of FTX's operations.
